title: FPT Software
description: fptsoftware.com FPT Software is the largest IT services company in Southeast Asia, founded in 1999 in Hanoi with 1.34 billion dollars in revenue and over 33,000 employees across 31 countries. It serves 1,100 clients including 130 Fortune Global 500 companies across automotive, banking, healthcare and energy, with Japan as its largest international market. Its AI-first strategy uses the FleziPT platform delivering 30 percent productivity gains, with AI and data services growing 60 percent in 2026. In 2025 it signed a record 256 million dollar AI transformation deal and secured 26 projects above 10 million dollars. Strategic partnerships span NVIDIA, Microsoft, SAP, AWS and OpenAI. Key strengths are unmatched scale from Vietnam, deep AI capabilities and a 152,000 strong education talent pipeline.
